# Phased checked formal operations and access

Ordinary before-code candidate for #32, within existing Reference rules. Root
selected this phased route after reading the independent candidate and actual
first observations. It grants no constitutional interpretation, guarantee,
public grammar/API, native authority or Issue completion. No production change
is made by this document. Older design and source snapshots remain unchanged.

## Concrete unit and consumption

Add one private `frontend::formals::Formals<N, M>` over existing BinderKeys,
common `types::Type<N>` and common `ast::Access`. It owns original static ordinal
progress, preceding Natural/Basis key sets and an ordered map of checked formal
operations. Each operation owns its exact **ordinary** basis, optional finite
Meaning payload and canonical `[bool; 3]` access mask. The three slots are Apply,
Adjoint and Controlled, with one shared enum-to-slot rule. These are untrusted
declaration-checking facts, not another source AST or an accepted handle.

Each adapter advances one complete original static parameter at a time. Natural
and Basis advances update the shared preceding-key sets. The Op step invokes
the actual profile basis-checking callback with those borrowed sets, then the
existing Meaning refinement callback. It stores their owned results directly.
Access requirements subsequently grant a slot only to an actual local operation
key installed in this declaration; the first repeated slot rejects. No global
target or static compatibility candidate can replace the resolved local target.

Finite `Compiler::abstract_bindings` consumes and moves basis/Meaning/mask into
its real `Bindings` and `Operation`, retaining `Node::Abstract`, depth/nodes and
the exact existing identity string. Existing finite width/contract/matrix checks,
Meaning basis equality and charge-before-matrix-copy stay at the same stage.
Sized declaration consumes and moves the same kind of checked ordinary basis
into the existing single Q-wrapped `Scope.operations` type, with the actual mask.
No unchecked formal reconstruction, second mask derivation or independent
duplicate/unknown-target declaration policy remains after the shared judgment.
Facts are rebuilt for each current declaration check, never cached over a
publicly mutable finite Project.

Reuse common `ast::Access` directly in private sized `Requirement::Access`
instead of its current String. The existing indexed projection carries the
same Reference and original access span. Body/callee capability checks use the
same enum and canonical slot function; existing all-access provider cases keep
the identical three true values. This changes only a private representation:
it grants no new provider/effect/inverse/control permission and adds no AST.

## Original association and projection boundary

Use the retained original Decl associated by resolved DefId → module → ast_index,
and the existing finite Forest or sized indexed projection/Table. Keep complete
static/runtime pairing assertions and additionally assert complete requirements
pairing before ordinal access; never zip-truncate. At the actual original ordinal,
assert the source static kind agrees with projected kind and actual Table binder
kind/key. A name/span equality may check paired metadata; it must never locate
an original node or reconstruct identity. Source/projection parameters and
requirements are neither skipped nor filtered.

This route does **not** rebuild a whole original Index or add a Natural address
map/AST recovery in the declaration pass. It consumes existing projected Natural
UseSiteIds/local BinderKeys and exact common type trees. The early indexed
projection's Named-type category rejection remains at its current boundary;
ordered availability is checked later, where it currently belongs. Discarded
preflight projections never supply checked formals.

## Sized borrowed kind environment and exact scheduling

Keep static name uniqueness/all-Nat Linear insertion, natural premises and
feasibility before ordered kinds. Whole-declaration premises do not make a later
Nat available to an earlier kind. Scope.bases is inserted once after each shared
Basis advance; the shared state supplies preceding sets to the Op callback.
No whole Scope clone is used for a kind: borrow actual naturals, bases, context
and the preceding-key sets. Do not clone owner/moved/operation maps, binding
identity counters or the linear context to manufacture an artificial kind scope.

Factor the current `ty` normalization so ordinary callers keep their current
signature and unrestricted environment. The kind path borrows an optional
allowed-key view. Its **full Parameter availability/substitution-capacity scan
still runs before all Natural normalization**. Then `map_parts` preserves type
shape and runs sizes in the same order. Keep b.storage_size, type cell/depth
checks, default/root/parameter spans and current substitution accounting.

Keep `linear::natural` as its existing internal wrapper. Add the optional
allowed-Natural-key lookup to the same recursive normalization, threading it
through every nested call with the same `at()` frames, left/right order,
overflow behavior, subtraction proof and nonlinear failure. A named Natural
lookup uses its actual local key and the existing value map, gated by the shared
preceding set. There is no eager occurrence/name precheck and no fallback by
spelling. No prefix map or entire scope is reconstructed. The full current
premise context remains borrowed unchanged.

Finite keeps complete profile/resolution/dependency and signature name/type
checks before Op basis/Meaning/access. Sized keeps complete per-module/indexed
projection before declaration checks; then premises, ordered kinds, access,
each runtime name/type/bind, result and complete body/effect checks. Runtime
pattern/name judgments and existing static-shadow rules are unchanged.
Finite unsupported Nat/Basis/Bits/Named/predicate barriers remain barriers;
sized unsupported Meaning-refined Op/Basis/Meaning declarations remain explicit
projection rejections. This factor does not widen either profile.

## Actual first evidence and correction to earlier predictions

Root executed the frozen formal collector once: terminal exit 0, forty complete
checks, six successes, thirty-four source/semantic rejections and forty-six
**pre-execv forwarded attempt rows**. These rows do not independently attest
native starts/exits. Raw observations live in
`tests/fixtures/authoring_sessions/common-formal-access-v030/before/` and remain
immutable. This author read the summary and selected actual JSON/source slices;
it did not run the collector, CLI, native checker or tests.

The selected mixed-kind control reports unavailable B at 125..126 before the
earlier nonlinear n*n. The Natural-only control reports nonlinear n*n at
119..122 before later k. Static/runtime collision reports finite ownership at
U 106..107 versus selected access at Apply 146..151. Unused missing access still
rejects both routes; finite recorded one forwarded attempt, selected zero.
Forward kinds retain their genuine earlier finite profile barriers and selected
unknown-Natural/unavailable-Basis errors. No early profile rejection is evidence
of a downstream shared judgment.

**Additive span correction:** earlier next-unit/candidate prose called the sized
access location a whole-constraint span. Actual Source AccessConstraint.span
currently covers the access keyword. The second duplicate highlights Apply
145..150 in selected mode; finite highlights its target U 151..152. Unknown
access targets preserve selected keyword spans and finite target-name spans.
The original prose is retained as prior prediction; actual frozen diagnostics
govern parity. Do not repair the sources or normalize these differences away.

## Implementation scope and completion checks

Explicit production scope: new frontend/formals.rs, frontend/mod.rs module
declaration, frontend/compile/operations.rs, frontend/sized/check.rs,
frontend/sized/linear.rs, and the two mechanical private projection files
frontend/sized/ast.rs and frontend/sized/parser.rs. No resolver/loader/source
collection change, original-Index cache, parser grammar, dependency, native/Lean,
stdlib, schema, edition or public Rust API change is required. Root must post
the concrete #32 checkpoint and release capture guards before source edits;
builds wait until root releases the remaining binary/capture guards.

After implementation, replay all forty fixed raw comparisons without changing
source/manifest bytes or expected outcomes: status, text/JSON, native attempt
argv/count and any actual proposal bytes. Retain genuine build/diagnostic
failures additively. Validate actual current/MSRV toolchains, relevant existing
type/Basis/operation/unused/zero-fold tests, format and all-target compile/lint.
Review both real consumers and movement of the shared facts independently.
Preserve each existing capacity/work limit; add no maximum/stress case and no
mirrored helper-only test as a substitute for actual declaration paths.

QS/PR/RS/EXACT status and the two ordinary decoded QLV1 guarantees are unchanged.
Formal access is an explicit generic assumption, not mathematical provider or
source/artifact correspondence evidence. The unit does not finish common
generic body checking, finite profile convergence, general Meaning, canonical
std/QFT exposure, universal algorithm proofs, source preservation, quantity
guarantees, #32/#317 or same-commit release gates. No Issue count is reduced.
